mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ilink_inbound_message ( bot_id, message_id, sender_id, conversation_id, status, attempt_count, first_received_at, last_received_at, lease_id, lease_until ) VALUES ( #{botId}, #{messageId}, #{senderId}, #{conversationId}, 'PROCESSING', 1, #{firstReceivedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{now, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{leaseId}, #{leaseUntil, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler} ) ON CONFLICT (bot_id, message_id) DO UPDATE SET sender_id = excluded.sender_id, conversation_id = excluded.conversation_id, status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_received_at = excluded.last_received_at, lease_id = excluded.lease_id, lease_until = excluded.lease_until, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, completed_at = NULL WHERE status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'DEAD') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= excluded.last_received_at) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= excluded.last_received_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE ilink_inbound_message SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, last_received_at = #{completedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_id = #{leaseId}

UPDATE ilink_inbound_message SET
status = 'DEAD', next_attempt_at = NULL,
status = 'FAILED', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler},
last_error = #{error}, lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE bot_id = #{botId} AND message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_id = #{leaseId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ilink_inbound_message WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'COMPLETED', 'DEAD') AND last_received_at < #{cutoff, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}
